title: Being a “guest speller” is such a bucket list item for me!  One day 🙏...
transcript: Here is everything you need to know about being a guest speller in the off Broadway revival of 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee. And I definitely recommend favoriting this video and watching until the end because they're actually doing a lot of things differently than past productions have. If you don't know, one of the fun parts of Spelling Bee as a musical is that every show, they invite four members of the audience up on stage to join the Bee. So if you are picked, you get to go up on stage and sit next to the cast, spell some words, and you may even participate in some of the musical numbers, and you are up there until you are eliminated. And the way that you can get picked is by signing up at this stand before the show. It is right next to the merch booth. You cannot miss it. They actually ended up closing down submissions very early. They cut off the line at our show at 7:38 for an 8 p. M. Show. So over 20 minutes before the show even started. So if you wanna sign up, I definitely recommend getting there early. The actual sign up process is pretty easy. They give you a form to fill out. It includes things like your name, your age, and some facts about yourself. And then when you hand in your paper, they will review your answers with you and they may even ask you some Questions about your answers. Then shortly after submissions close, they actually told us who the four people would be. Usually with the show, you do not find out if you were chosen until the show actually starts, but here they told us around 7:42. And then we're able to prep those people in advance with what to expect. As for exactly what they're looking for, it's really hard to say. They definitely strive to get a wide variety of age, gender, and ethnicities. They usually choose at least one kid, for example. The only advice I can really give is to just be personable, smile, give off good energy, and then it's just up to fate.
showTitle: The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee
classificationReason: Primarily an informational/how-to guide about the guest speller process at this off-Broadway revival. Creator attended ('at our show') but expresses no opinion on the production's acting, direction, or quality—no review content.
